thread:
maya: Heads-up — p99 looks fine at the route level but when I break it down by endpoint the p95 stays stable and p99 jumps on /v1/generate in eu-west after the routing weight flip. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
lia: Yep saw the same. p95 flat, p99 spikes only for that endpoint + carrier tag. Could be sample-count weirdness or a fallback change.
deploy-bot: deployment maya/route-weight-update succeeded (rev=weight-flip-2026-03-20-18:22Z) :rocket:
sam: Quick query I ran from the console to show what I'm seeing:
```
SELECT endpoint, count(*) as n, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.5) as p50, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) as p95, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99) as p99
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE route = 'chat-prod' AND region = 'eu-west'
AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY endpoint
ORDER BY p99 DESC
```
sam: Results: /v1/generate p99=1720ms n=62, /v1/chat p99=320ms n=2400 — so p99 is from a tiny sample.
oleg: Small sample for the endpoint + t-digest merge across shards can make p99 jumpy. We also saw this when failing over to smaller hosts that had different batching.
ryan: Can we check KV cache hits? If /v1/generate is cache-sensitive, a route weight change could move heat and cause cache cold starts -> tail latency.
dashbot: dashboard snapshot: https://console.redwood.local/d/latency/route-chat-prod?panel=endpoint-breakdown&from=now-30m (scroll to endpoint list) :eyes:
priya: UX idea: show sample count (n) as an overlay for each percentile in the console and grey out p99 if n < 200 (or configurable). Also show last model-variant/fallback used per bucket.
lia: +1. We should also expose the sampling provenance badge (route vs gateway vs fallback) next to the percentile so folks don't misinterpret tiny-n p99s.
maya: Action items: 1) Oleg/ryan — check shard merge/t-digest params and KV cache hit rates for the timeframe (ovid: 30m around 18:22Z). 2) Dash/UX — add sample-count overlay for endpoint breakdown (low effort badge). 3) Sam/ops — add a quick console query in Runbook to flag p99 when n < threshold.
oleg: I'll dump t-digest hist sizes and sampling rates and post logs in this thread in 10m.
ryan: I'll correlate kv_cache_hit_ratio by endpoint and host. If it's cache miss > 50% coincident with weight flip, that's our culprit.
dashbot: Filed: PROJ-542 add endpoint-sample-overlay to endpoint-breakdown panel.}
priya: One more: add tooltip explaining "why p99 moved" linking to runbook section on sample size & fallback.
maya: Perfect. If anyone else spots other routes with the same pattern, drop them here. :thumbsup:
